plan.question: Sensitivity of tau=4 closed-loop null attention to burn12 vs24
plan.estimator: directed nonself recipient-sender edges, equal replicate weighting

decision_rule.scope: flag each affected gain at tau4; if common block required use24 for tau4 and its comparison references

limitations: four independent seeds only; no test of full stationarity
same-seed evaluation segments are12-24s and24-36s, so both memory transient and trajectory variation contribute
edge samples within a replicate are not independent replicates
no response trial or response-derived tuning is permitted in this check
